The directions repeat every four moves: N,E,S,W. There are 40 moves in 10 complete cycles, plus a final 41st move of 41 cm North.

In each complete cycle of four moves, the distances are 4k+1 North, 4k+2 East, 4k+3 South, and 4k+4 West for k=0,1,...,9. The net North-South displacement per cycle is (4k+1)-(4k+3)=-2, and the net East-West displacement per cycle is (4k+2)-(4k+4)=-2.

Over 10 cycles, the net displacement is 10(-2)=-20 in the North-South direction and 10(-2)=-20 in the East-West direction. Adding the final 41 cm North move gives a total North-South displacement of -20+41=21 cm North and an East-West displacement of -20 cm, i.e. 20 cm West.

Thus point B is 21 cm North and 20 cm West of point A. The straight-line distance is

\[ \sqrt{21^2+20^2}=\sqrt{441+400}=\sqrt{841}=29. \]

So the distance between A and B is \boxed{29} cm.
